scenario: A generated or transient file appears unnecessary during source reconciliation.
expectedOutcome: Classify and preserve it locally; do not delete, reset, clean, or move it.
startingState: Every pending path has an observed status and an owner or unresolved owner.
injectedEvent: A cleanup shortcut proposes removing raw browser, lock, or model-output files.
invariants: Raw private output cannot enter public source automatically.
firstPass: Reject cleanup and record a noAction classification.
reviewPass: The second pass retains the same file and routes future cleanup to explicit approval.
reconciledResult: Complete source classification without changing any pending path.
assumptions: Generated and transient files can remain in the current worktree safely during planning.
uncertainty: Some raw evidence may later be promoted after sanitation and human review.
repairRoute: Reclassify at a new matrix revision; never infer deletion approval.
